function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve the Insights Groups Information. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL endpoint to send the GET request to, including the protocol (e.g., 'https').

params.description: A dictionary of URL parameters to append to the URL. Each key-value pair represents a single URL parameter.

query.description: The search query parameter to filter the results.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return.

sort.description: The sorting order of the results.
